description: Header file defining the ocudu::transport_layer_address class, which represents and manipulates transport layer network addresses, including creation, comparison, and formatting functions.

classes.name: transport_layer_address
classes.description: Represents a network transport layer address with methods for creation, comparison, and formatting.

methods.name: create_from_string
methods.description: Creates a transport_layer_address from an IPv4 or IPv6 string.

methods.name: create_from_bitstring
methods.description: Creates a transport_layer_address from a bitstring.

methods.name: create_from_sockaddr
methods.description: Creates a transport_layer_address from a sockaddr structure.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts the address to its string representation.

methods.name: to_bitstring
methods.description: Converts the address to a bitstring.

methods.name: native
methods.description: Returns the native POSIX sockaddr representation.

methods.name: set_port
methods.description: Sets the port number of the address.
